Volume optimization.Strategy: Cautious volume loading (saline or Ringer's lactate), e.g. ~500 mL over 15–30 min
Volume optimization.Properties and use: Consider in patients with normal-to-low central venous pressure (eg, concomitant hypovolaemia)
Volume optimization.Caveats: Volume loading can over-distend the RV, worsen ventricular interdependence, and reduce cardiac output

Vasopressors and inotropes.Properties and use: Increases RV inotropy and systemic blood pressure, promotes positive ventricular interactions, and restores coronary perfusion gradient
Vasopressors and inotropes.Caveats: Excessive vasoconstriction may worsen tissue perfusion

Vasopressors and inotropes.Properties and use: Increases RV inotropy, lowers filling pressures
Vasopressors and inotropes.Caveats: May aggravate arterial hypotension if used alone without a vasopressor; may trigger or aggravate arrhythmias

Mechanical circulatory support.Properties and use: Rapid short-term support combined with oxygenator
Mechanical circulatory support.Caveats: Complications with use over longer periods (>5–10 days) including bleeding and infections; no clinical benefit unless combined with surgical embolectomy in some contexts; requires an experienced team
